- **Completed inspections (Pass, Fail, Pass w/ Conditions):** 11,426 (7,198 Pass, 1,805 Pass w/ Conditions)

I used the completed-inspection denominator because it excludes results where no inspection actually happened. If you count every restaurant inspection record in 2025, including No Entry, Out of Business, Not Ready and Business Not Located (2,439 records), the Fail share is **17.5%** (2,423 of 13,865).

**Method:** I filtered Chicago's Food Inspections dataset (`4ijn-s7e5`) to `facility_type = 'Restaurant'` and inspection dates from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, then grouped by `results`. "Last year" was read as calendar 2025, since today is November 2026.

**Limitations:**
- The dataset records each visit's outcome, so a restaurant inspected more than once in 2025 counts once per visit.
- The dataset may contain some duplicate reports, which the publisher notes.
- Results reflect inspectors' findings at the time of each visit.

# Chicago Restaurant Inspections — 2025 Failure Rate

## Key Metrics

| Result | Inspections | Share of all |
|--------|------------:|-------------:|
| Pass | 10,388 | 54.1% |
| Pass w/ Conditions | 2,281 | 11.9% |
| **Fail** | **3,391** | **17.7%** |
| No Entry | 1,415 | 7.4% |
| Out of Business | 1,284 | 6.7% |
| Not Ready | 444 | 2.3% |
| Business Not Located | 2 | 0.0% |
| **Total** | **19,205** | **100%** |

## Findings

- **17.7% of all inspections in 2025 ended in "Fail"** (3,391 of 19,205).
- Among inspections with a definitive outcome (Pass, Pass w/ Conditions, or Fail — 16,060 total), **21.1% failed**.
- "Pass w/ Conditions" (11.9%) means the facility passed but had violations requiring correction — if you count those as partial failures, **29.5% of definitive inspections had issues**.

## Data Source

Chicago Food Inspections dataset (`4ijn-s7e5`, data.cityofchicago.org), filtered to `inspection_date` in 2025. This covers all food establishments inspected by the city, not just restaurants — the dataset includes schools, daycares, warehouses, and other licensed food facilities. Filtering strictly to `facility_type = 'Restaurant'` would give a narrower, restaurant-only figure.

**Limitations:** "No Entry," "Not Ready," and "Out of Business" outcomes are administrative, not pass/fail judgments — they're excluded from the definitive-outcome rate above.
